name: The Journey TCG
customHelp:
Learn to play at https://www.journeytcg.com/how-to-play

In front of your Adventurers: their total Agility and HP. Edit them directly, the turn order updates for everyone. The arrow button is Step Back. The button on the left resets the Agility of all your Adventurers to their printed value.
Hold C to add counters to your Adventurer and count Focus.

The bar in the middle shows the Agility order of all Adventurers. Blue = yours, red = opponents, dashed = Step Back, faded = already acted.
The Adventurers whose turn it is are highlighted. When it's one of yours, click Pass once you're done to let the next Adventurers act.
Once the battle block is complete, all players have to pass their turn (press space or click the arrow button at the top left of your screen) to start the next turn.

Enhancements go in the zone to the right of their Adventurer, Hidden abilities face down in the zone behind it. Lasting cards go in the Lasting zone on the left.
Used cards go face down in the Cycle, bottom right. When your deck is empty, the Cycle is shuffled back into it.

Default backgrounds by Misoshiru Studio.
